full_prompt_en: A square historical oil painting shows a gathering of robed men seated around a low round table in a richly decorated interior. A large shadowed arch opens at the back left, while patterned plaster, blue tile, a hanging textile, and two circular metal trays fill the right wall. The group forms a broad semicircle around the brass-toned table. At the left foreground, a man in a vivid turquoise robe and white wrapped head covering sits with his back partly to the viewer. Beside him, a figure in striped fabric and a warm turban turns toward the center. Two men in pale robes occupy the middle distance, their faces emerging from the deep shade beneath the arch. On the right, a hooded pale figure faces the table, and a red-robed man with a white head wrap sits with his back toward the viewer. Small cups, vessels, and dishes crowd the tabletop, their metallic surfaces picking up sharp warm highlights. A patterned red rug runs along the lower foreground over pale floor slabs. Soft daylight enters from the front left, catching the turquoise and crimson cloth, the table, and the seated faces, while the archway recedes into brown shadow. Meticulous oil brushwork distinguishes embroidered fabric, glazed tile, worn stone, and reflective metal. The overall composition is intimate and richly layered, using saturated cloth against ocher architecture and deep shadow to concentrate attention on the shared table.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形历史题材油画呈现一群身着长袍的男子，围坐在装饰繁复室内的一张低矮圆桌旁。左后方开着巨大的阴影拱门，右侧墙面则布满纹饰灰泥、蓝色瓷砖、悬挂织物和两只圆形金属盘。众人围着黄铜色桌子形成宽阔半圆。左侧前景，一名身穿鲜亮青蓝长袍、头缠白布的男子半背向观者而坐。旁边穿条纹布料、戴暖色头巾的人物转向中央。两名浅色长袍男子处于中间深度，面孔从拱门下的深影里浮现。右侧，一名浅衣带兜帽的人朝向桌子；一名穿红袍、头裹白布的男子背向观者坐着。小杯、器皿和餐盘挤满桌面，金属表面接住锐利的暖色高光。一条带纹样的红毯从下部前景横过浅色地砖。柔和日光从左前方进入，照亮青蓝与深红布料、桌面和坐着的人们的脸，拱门则退入棕色阴影。细密油画笔触区分刺绣布料、釉面瓷砖、磨旧石材与反光金属。整体构图亲密而层次丰厚，以饱和布料对照赭色建筑和深影，把注意力集中到众人共享的桌子上。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted surface combines precise material detail with warm, theatrical shadow. Ocher, umber, and muted terracotta form a deep setting, while compact passages of saturated turquoise and red provide strong color anchors. Repeating arches, circular ornaments, and patterned bands organize the busy frame without making it flat. Matte folds, glossy small highlights, glazed pattern, and rough masonry each retain distinct brush texture. Soft light from one side illuminates the nearer planes and gradually gives way to a dark recessed zone, creating convincing layered depth. The composition gathers many forms around a lower central focus; overlapping silhouettes hold the group together. Fine edges sharpen where light meets ornament, while distant details merge into warm shadow. The overall effect is opulent, calm, and tactile, with color accents emerging from richly modeled brown space.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面把精确的材质细节与温暖、带舞台感的阴影结合。赭黄、棕褐与低调赤陶色形成深沉环境，紧凑的饱和青蓝与红色段落成为强烈色彩锚点。重复的拱线、圆形饰纹和图案带组织繁忙画幅，却没有把它压平。哑光褶面、细小光泽高光、釉面纹样与粗石各自保留不同笔触质地。一侧柔光照亮近处平面，逐渐让位给深色凹处，形成可信的层叠深度。构图将许多形态聚向偏下的中心焦点；互相遮挡的剪影把整体连在一起。光与纹饰相遇处边缘变得清晰，远处细节则融进暖影。整体效果丰华、平静而可触，彩色重音从塑形丰富的棕色空间中浮现。
theme_en: A gathering around a low table in an ornate interior
theme_zh: 华丽室内中围坐在低桌旁的一群人
name: Rudolf Ernst
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
